title: MCP mailbox acknowledgement drops a host-reported unknown outcome to plain text instead of the typed termal-mailbox-outcome result
outcome: A mailbox acknowledgement whose outcome the host itself reports as unknown (a server error carrying the unknown-outcome clause) reaches the MCP client as the same typed result as send and read, while known refusals keep plain text.
acceptance: MCP mailbox acknowledgement drops a host-reported unknown outcome to plain text instead of the typed termal-mailbox-outcome result is done
